_comment: CURATED (Addendum A.2 Tier 2, A.10). Component -> score-sheet line -> maximum deduction. Ingestion must NEVER generate entries here.
status_reason: The current development corpus contains no IAC/PFA score sheet. The IAC/PFA Judging Guidelines establish the 100-point basis and a 0-5 point per-component deduction range at judge discretion, but define no score-sheet line items and no per-line maximum deductions. Per A.10, a maximum deduction may never appear alone and an unmapped component means both fields are omitted. Until a score sheet is supplied and mappings are curated, the assistant can present Correct Specification only - never Applicable Score Sheet Line, never Maximum Deduction.
required_to_populate: IAC/PFA Engine and Chassis score sheet
